meta.name: hybrid-cloud-networking
meta.description: Configure secure, high-performance connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms using VPN and dedicated connections. Use when building hybrid cloud architectures, connecting data centers to cloud, or implementing secure cross-premises networking.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在本地数据中心与云平台间建立安全连接
copy.tagline_en: Connect your on-premises data center to cloud securely

howto.what: 帮你规划并写出本地数据中心与云(AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI)之间的连接配置:VPN 或专线、Terraform 代码、BGP 路由与双隧道高可用。
howto.when: 当你要把本地数据中心接入云端、搭建混合云架构,或需要满足合规与分阶段迁移等场景时触发。

howto.what_en: Plans and writes on-premises-to-cloud connectivity configs (VPN or dedicated links) for AWS, Azure, GCP and OCI: Terraform code, BGP routing, dual-tunnel HA and monitoring commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you connect a data center to a cloud, build hybrid cloud architectures, or meet compliance and gradual migration needs.
